ModMetaData.name: RimVision (1.7 patch)
ModMetaData.author: Papaya
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial RimWorld 1.7 patch of RimVision 0.0.4 pre-release v2: shaders ported to the 1.7 engine, rebuilt against 1.7. Use instead of the Workshop version, not alongside it.
0.0.4 pre-release v2
RIMVISION
See your colony through your colonists' eyes.
Walk through your base, visit its workshops and personally face a raid at the gates. RimVision adds a 3D colony view and direct first-person control of your colonists.
FEATURES
• Explore your colony in 3D and switch between an overview and first-person view. • Control a colonist, fight and interact with the world. • Build, carry resources, perform work and designate zones. • Manage inventory, change equipment, eat, sleep and tend injuries. • View your character's health, skills, mood and social relationships. • Experience lighting, shadows, rain, snow, water and fire effects. • Adjust the camera, image quality, interface and additional effects.
Under direct control, you move the character to workstations and required items yourself. Skills, needs and restrictions continue to follow RimWorld's rules.
GETTING STARTED
O: enter 3D or return to the standard view. V: switch between overview and first-person view. In overview, V enters the clicked colonist. Hover highlights a pawn; click selects. Right click open ground to move, or a pawn/object for native actions. Shift + right click adds waypoints or queues actions. Subtle trails show routes and glowing circles show destinations. Space pauses/resumes overview; commands are issued directly in the scene. WASD: move. Mouse: look around. Alt: release the cursor. E in peaceful mode: primary interaction/work; hold E to choose an item amount or sow. E also uses stairs and ladders. Right mouse button: native action menu; aim in combat. F: combat mode. Left mouse button: attack in combat mode. F8: export the single selected object, its sprite, in-game description, size and starter prompt to the ComfyUI RimVision input folder. Open the RimVision latest-export workflow and queue it to load the newest export automatically. B: construction and zones. Tab: character and inventory. Q: cancel the current action.
Contextual hints show additional controls. Middle mouse drag rotates the overview camera. A ground-cell outline previews command placement. Overview supports Architect and searchable colony/mod tabs. V enters the selected or nearest controllable colonist. Immersive Warfare's native weapon slots appear at the lower left in first person; hold Alt to use the cursor. Ammo and time-speed indicators are shown on the HUD. RimVision settings include Tactics and compatibility for outline/path colors, menu scale and automatic model fallbacks. The Weapon and hand editor button is always available at the top of RimVision settings.
REQUIREMENTS
• RimWorld 1.7. • Harmony, loaded before RimVision.
COMPATIBILITY
Tactical overview, queued native orders, target inspection, modded weapon fallback, AASB stairs and ladders, and optional Facial Animation, Interaction Bubbles, Target Priority and Immersive Warfare integrations are included in this fork. Open RimVision settings and select Tactics and compatibility. Disable the old separate compatibility add-on.
Multiplayer requires the separate RimVision – Multiplayer Compatibility mod and matching mod versions on all clients. Desync-free play has not yet been confirmed.
Compatibility with Combat Extended and other major mods requires separate testing. Back up your save before adding the mod to an existing colony. Safe removal from a save has not been confirmed.
ABOUT THE MOD
The mod is in active development. Bugs and limitations may occur. When reporting an issue, include the game log, your mod list and steps to reproduce it.
